key.name: enable-tiling
key.description: Whether the automatic tiling engine is currently active.

key.name: default-layout
key.description: Default tiling layout algorithm (dynamic-grid, master-stack, horizontal-split, vertical-split, adaptive-grid).

key.name: inner-gap
key.description: Spacing in pixels between adjacent tiled windows.

key.name: outer-gap
key.description: Margin in pixels around the perimeter of the screen or work area.

key.name: horizontal-gap
key.description: Horizontal spacing in pixels between adjacent window columns.

key.name: vertical-gap
key.description: Vertical spacing in pixels between adjacent window rows.

key.name: floating-applications
key.summary: Floating application IDs or WM classes
key.description: List of application IDs or WM classes that should always float by default.

key.name: toggle-tiling
key.description: Shortcut to enable or disable automatic window tiling.

key.name: focus-left
key.description: Shortcut to navigate focus to the left window.

key.name: focus-right
key.description: Shortcut to navigate focus to the right window.

key.name: focus-up
key.description: Shortcut to navigate focus to the window above.

key.name: focus-down
key.description: Shortcut to navigate focus to the window below.

key.name: move-left
key.summary: Swap or move window to the left
key.description: Shortcut to swap or move the active window to the left.

key.name: move-right
key.summary: Swap or move window to the right
key.description: Shortcut to swap or move the active window to the right.

key.name: move-up
key.description: Shortcut to swap or move the active window up.

key.name: move-down
key.description: Shortcut to swap or move the active window down.

key.name: toggle-floating
key.description: Shortcut to toggle active window between floating and tiled mode.

key.name: cycle-layout
key.description: Shortcut to cycle active workspace layout algorithm.

key.name: move-to-workspace-up
key.description: Shortcut to move focused window to the previous workspace.

key.name: move-to-workspace-down
key.description: Shortcut to move focused window to the next workspace.

key.name: move-to-monitor-left
key.summary: Move window to monitor on the left
key.description: Shortcut to move focused window to the left monitor.

key.name: move-to-monitor-right
key.summary: Move window to monitor on the right
key.description: Shortcut to move focused window to the right monitor.
